name: pdf
description: PDF production skills and a PDF viewer panel, published as an official NIBI plugin.

description_i18n.en: PDF production skills: typeset and render reports, resumes, posters, and covers to PDF. View PDFs in a side panel: reference passages in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture pages.
description_i18n.zh-CN: PDF 制作技能：报告、简历、海报、封面的排版与渲染输出；并可在侧栏查看 PDF，把内容引用到对话，Agent 可以阅读、搜索、定位高亮并截取页面；另附 NIBI 的工具链：LibreOffice 真引擎重算、字号/压盖/缺字形等硬判据门禁。
